payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a data-dense dashboard. Use: multiple chart widgets, KPI cards row, data tables with sorting, minimal padding (8-12px), efficient grid layout, filter sidebar, dense but readable typography, maximum information density.
payload.best_for: Business intelligence dashboards, financial analytics, enterprise reporting, operational dashboards, data warehousing
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr), gap: 8px, padding: 12px, font-size: 12-14px, overflow: auto for tables, compact card design, sticky headers
payload.do_not_use_for: Marketing dashboards, consumer-facing analytics, simple reporting
payload.effects_and_animation: Hover tooltips, chart zoom on click, row highlighting on hover, smooth filter animations, data loading spinners
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Grid layout 12 columns, ☐ KPI cards responsive, ☐ Tables sortable, ☐ Filters functional, ☐ Loading states for data, ☐ Export functionality
payload.keywords: Multiple charts/widgets, data tables, KPI cards, minimal padding, grid layout, space-efficient, maximum data visibility
payload.primary_colors: Neutral primary (light grey/white #F5F5F5), data colors (blue/green/red), dark text #333333
payload.secondary_colors: Chart colors: success (green #22C55E), warning (amber #F59E0B), alert (red #EF4444), neutral (grey)
